entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Allow me to disclose the results of our[n]examination.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If I had to describe your current state...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I would say you are: One Who Has Yet[n]to Learn His Place in the World.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You were probably feeling all confident[n]in yourself when you challenged us, right?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: There's nothing you can say after a[n]miserable defeat like that though.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, it would not be interesting if[n]you quit here.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Accept this. Think of it as... a participation[n]award.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Prepare well if you wish to hold a true[n]battle. Ordinary effort alone cannot[n]overturn this result.
